verdict.rationale: Vercel documents managing environment variables across environments (docs-23), scoped access tokens for team/project resources (vercel-supp-scoped-tokens), and team-level auth via identity provider (docs-13), which covers core devops-lead needs. However, evidence lacks detail on centralized secrets management UI/API, granular RBAC/role management, or audit logging across a team, and a community security incident thread raises concerns about lack of clarity on rotating secrets after a breach (vercel-comm-5, vercel-comm-6), though this critiques incident response transparency rather than disproving the core capability. Missing for 10: dedicated secrets-manager documentation, granular team role/permission docs, audit-log evidence, and independent corroboration of secure secret handling at scale.
